protocol.status: Frozen before the first v3 training run
protocol.architecture: Eight bounded learned content-addressed slots with shared key/query projection, generic C1 closed write gate, optional diagonal fast/slow neuron
protocol.ablation: hcsn and sigmoid differ only in q shape; memory_only removes dynamic neuron states and retains generic content-addressed memory
protocol.optimizer: Adam with global gradient norm clipped to 1
protocol.checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation cross entropy every 50 updates
protocol.budget_statement: Approximately matched parameters and exactly matched data/minibatches/updates, not matched persistent state or FLOPs
protocol.attribution_target: An option-specific benefit requires a repeatable advantage over same-graph sigmoid and cannot be inferred from adding memory
protocol.timing: Use next/common.py strong-dtype precompiled trainer; report training and pure-logits inference separately
protocol.scope: Fresh synthetic holdouts, no full financial-kernel claim unless a separately named variant explicitly uses it

metadata.evaluation_policy: All architectural choices frozen; checkpoints chosen only by validation loss
limitations: One shared synthetic task family; no real-world or backbone superiority
Matched updates/data/approximately parameters, not state size or FLOPs
Common training timings include first AOT dispatch but no compilation or warmup updates
